description: This file is a PHP script for generating an HTML web form for capturing leads and web-to-lead form processing within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes form setup, configuration, and rendering logic, as well as integrating TinyMCE for rich text editing.

classes.name: SugarTinyMCE
classes.description: Class for initializing and configuring TinyMCE rich text editor within the form.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Static method of WebToLeadFormBuilder that generates the HTML for the web-to-lead form based on provided parameters.

methods.name: ifRadioButton
methods.description: Checks if a custom field is of type 'radioenum' by querying the fields_meta_data table.
